title: nanobot
oneLiner: Lightweight open-source AI agent that connects to your tools, chats, and workflows for automation.
summary: nanobot is a lightweight open-source AI agent from the University of Hong Kong (HKU) designed for tool orchestration and workflow automation. It provides a minimal surface area for connecting AI to everyday tools, chats, and processes — with support for extensible tool integrations.
whyItMatters: nanobot represents a growing trend toward minimal, focused AI agents that do one thing well. With 43K+ GitHub stars and a lightweight architecture, it is a practical choice for developers who want to add AI automation to their existing tools without adopting a heavy framework.
bestFor: Developers adding AI automation to existing tools and workflows without heavy framework dependencies
Teams evaluating lightweight agent architectures for tool orchestration
Builders who prefer minimal, focused agents over full-stack agent platforms
notFor: Complex multi-agent workflows requiring conversation orchestration and role management
Production systems requiring enterprise-grade monitoring and observability
seoTitle: nanobot: Lightweight Open-Source AI Agent for Tools & Workflows
seoDescription: nanobot is a lightweight open-source AI agent from HKU that integrates with your tools, chats, and workflows for automation and task execution.
shareDescription: Lightweight, open-source AI agent for your tools, chats, and workflows.

seoArticle.whatItIs: nanobot is a lightweight open-source AI agent from HKU for connecting AI to tools, chats, and workflows. It focuses on minimal architecture and extensible tool integrations.
seoArticle.whyItMatters: nanobot demonstrates that effective AI agents don't need complex frameworks. Its lightweight design makes it approachable for developers new to agent development.

faq.question: What makes nanobot different from other AI agents?
faq.answer: nanobot focuses on minimalism and extensibility — it is designed to be lightweight while providing a clean interface for tool integration.

faq.question: Can I extend nanobot with custom tools?
faq.answer: Yes, nanobot supports extensible tool integrations through its plugin-like architecture.

faq.question: Is nanobot open source?
faq.answer: Yes, it is open source under the MIT license with 43K+ GitHub stars.

faq.question: Does nanobot require cloud infrastructure?
faq.answer: No, nanobot is designed to be lightweight and can run locally or on minimal infrastructure.
